title: Purchase Program Rate Shares for Trade-In Mileage Deductions
content:
The program rate share in the mileage deduction under **Trade-In Agreements** depends on the vehicle program of the purchase order the trade is applied to, as that order shows it under **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**.

| Vehicle program of the purchase the trade is applied to | Program rate share |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 0.8 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 0.8 |
| Kestrel Certified | 0.9 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 0.9 |
| Any other program | One (no reduction) |

The share multiplies the grade's mileage overage deduction per mile into the one rate at which the charged miles are priced; the mileage deduction is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Program schedule in brief

- Kestrel Premium Certified and Kestrel Factory Certified purchases take the upper-program share of 0.8.
- Kestrel Certified and Kestrel Certified Plus purchases take the certified-program share of 0.9.
- A purchase under any other program takes no reduction.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A trade applied to a Kestrel Certified Plus purchase, with a hypothetical grade rate of $0.12 per mile and 1250 miles charged: the rate becomes $0.12 multiplied by 0.9, which is $0.108, and 1250 miles at $0.108 is **$135.00**. Applied to a Kestrel Factory Certified purchase, the rate is $0.096 and the deduction $120.00.
